svg.title: Certificates: issue, duplicate, revoke
svg.desc: Choose the kind, then give the details: language, detail boxes and the next serial number; everything except the transfer certificate can be issued to a whole class at once. See the preview, then print; the serial number is assigned on Print. A reprint keeps the same serial number, raises the copy number and prints the duplicate label. When an admin revokes with a reason, the QR page shows revoked and the register shows it with the reason.
